note: Passages of the kind a notebook actually holds, and questions asked the way a marketing team asks them. Written by hand to choose a reranker on evidence rather than reputation; it measures the judgement of whoever wrote it, not a customer's, so it is a guard against a model being worse, not proof of how good one is. Questions deliberately avoid repeating the passage's distinctive words, because that is the case full-text search already handles and a reranker is supposed to cover.

passages.voice-plain: We write plainly and we never oversell. Say what a mattress does, not how it will change your life. Avoid superlatives unless a number backs them.
passages.voice-terms: Call them customers, never clients. The product is a mattress, not a sleep system. Our company name takes no article: Koala, not the Koala.
passages.pricing-plans: The Growth plan is $79 a month billed monthly, or $790 a year. The Starter plan is $39 a month and has no phone support.
passages.pricing-discount: We do not discount for enterprise buyers. Where a deal needs movement, extend the trial rather than cut the rate.
passages.support-sla: Support answers within one business day. Escalations go to the account lead, who owns the reply until it is closed.
passages.support-hours: The Sydney office is open nine to five on weekdays. There is no weekend cover and no on-call roster.
passages.rival-pricing: Ecosa charges $89 a month for its Growth tier, billed annually only. Their entry tier is $45 and excludes phone support.
passages.rival-claims: Ecosa's site leans on a hundred-night trial and free returns. They make no claim about firmness adjustment, which we do.
passages.report-visibility: AI visibility for August 2026 was 41.0%, up 5.5 points on July. ChatGPT accounted for most of the rise; Gemini was flat.
passages.report-blindspots: Four blindspots are open. The largest is a displacement on best mattress australia, where Ecosa is named and we are not.
passages.meeting-launch: We agreed to hold the autumn campaign until the new firmness page is live. Dana owns the page, due the second week of March.
passages.meeting-budget: Spend for the quarter is capped at forty thousand dollars, with a third reserved for the always-on search programme.
passages.compliance-claims: Any claim about spinal alignment needs a citation to the physiotherapy review. Do not describe the product as medically approved.
passages.compliance-returns: The trial runs a hundred and twenty nights. A return inside that window is free; after it, the customer pays freight.
